Dear Madam
I have now insured all the property.

The cottages for	1600
Your house		 800
,, possessions	 200
Olford house	 300	
[Mrs Bishop](../persons.html#156)s	 ,,	 200
Broadway	,,	 300
[Hicks](../persons.html#689)		,,
& shop			 360=
			£3760
The premium will all come due at one time, at Ladyday.

The amount now due after making allowance on the old policies not yet expired is £4.7.0 for which please send a cheque, this stands from now till Ladyday 1897.

Then the regular annual premium will be £4.13.9 of which notice will be given as usual
I am yours faithy
[Chas Wooldridge](../persons.html#2094) esq
Miss Yonge
I have put the policy with the deeds
